title: Make learned lessons self-correct from later outcomes

intent.outcome: Admitted learning from Memory, target guidance, repo improvement, and aids joins later authoritative outcomes through its existing owner revision and the canonical operating-decision identity; material results reuse existing consequence owners while inconclusive and ordinary uses stay quiet.
non_goals: Create a universal learning identifier, analytics database, or per-use compliance ledger.
Treat absence of recurrence or agent self-report as causal proof.
Implement stronger-owner promotion mechanics owned by issue #2812.

parent.contribution: Provide the sparse later-outcome effectiveness loop required before learning can be promoted safely.

effects: Operating decisions expose sparse, owner-revision-bound effectiveness only when later evidence exists.
Material findings flow through the existing context consequence compiler and destination owners.

delegation.reason: Session policy explicitly prohibits spawning sub-agents; the sequential stacked slice also shares the canonical operating-decision contract.

next_action: Implement owner-specific attribution adapters, compose their sparse findings into operating decisions, and validate the reviewed effectiveness matrix and traces.

claims: Make learned lessons self-correct from later outcomes is implemented, validated, and closed out honestly.
requirements: uv run --active pytest tests/test_learning_effectiveness.py tests/test_future_learning.py tests/test_memory_effectiveness.py tests/test_operating_decision.py -q
